reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Identical crouching Zanka with blue energy ribbons, rod held across body, urban wall with lettering and the same irregular creature/rock base. Source position 2 and canonical R2 cover have the same frontal composition.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Explicit visual comparison of sculpture, pose, base and framing; SHA-256 independently verified against the source artifact, and canonical dHash match corroborates rather than automatically determines identity.

mediaReview.notes: Both source and published cover include creator/promotional branding and Patreon reference; media usage rights remain unverified. Do not crop, erase marks, replace public covers or import source gallery as part of this identity decision.

decision.nextGate: Retain one existing model; separately validate provenance, attribution and usage rights for existing and proposed imagery.
